by_condition.parity_note: SleepGate is an architecture-level KV-cache intervention (neural forgetting gate + conflict-aware temporal tagger + slow-wave-sleep-replay consolidation module). The paper operates on transformer hidden state, NOT on a declarative concept memory. Author docstring (reorg_sleepgate.py:1-46) honestly discloses 'This does NOT literally map to mem2 declarative concept memory' and that what is ported is a 'conceptual pattern' (temporal supersession) translated to a hand-rolled rule-based eviction heuristic (older.used_in subset newer.used_in + token-overlap threshold). NO learned components. NO KV-cache operations. NO interference-horizon claims. Phase F R2=14 reflects an always-skipped gate (action='sleepgate_skipped' in Phase F artifact at outputs/two_round_axis_2/s42/ax2_reorg_sleepgate__ps_topk/round1/.../memory/final.json — evicted 0 concepts; memory unchanged from input). The R2=14 anomaly is most likely single-seed noise (~7pp floor) over no-mutation memory state. Cross-check: copilot read AGREED with Codex #6 verdict=Wrong 2026-05-12 (first surviving Wrong-tier port post-lilo-downgrade). Honest meeting framing: 'SleepGate-inspired concept-bank supersession heuristic (no relation to SleepGate's actual KV-cache mechanism)'.

results.parity_note: SleepGate is an architecture-level KV-cache intervention (neural forgetting gate + conflict-aware temporal tagger + slow-wave-sleep-replay consolidation module). The paper operates on transformer hidden state, NOT on a declarative concept memory. Author docstring (reorg_sleepgate.py:1-46) honestly discloses 'This does NOT literally map to mem2 declarative concept memory' and that what is ported is a 'conceptual pattern' (temporal supersession) translated to a hand-rolled rule-based eviction heuristic (older.used_in subset newer.used_in + token-overlap threshold). NO learned components. NO KV-cache operations. NO interference-horizon claims. Phase F R2=14 reflects an always-skipped gate (action='sleepgate_skipped' in Phase F artifact at outputs/two_round_axis_2/s42/ax2_reorg_sleepgate__ps_topk/round1/.../memory/final.json — evicted 0 concepts; memory unchanged from input). The R2=14 anomaly is most likely single-seed noise (~7pp floor) over no-mutation memory state. Cross-check: copilot read AGREED with Codex #6 verdict=Wrong 2026-05-12 (first surviving Wrong-tier port post-lilo-downgrade). Honest meeting framing: 'SleepGate-inspired concept-bank supersession heuristic (no relation to SleepGate's actual KV-cache mechanism)'.
